units.source_text: 这尊基督雕像的灯笼，不知道是从前的信仰象征呢，还是旧时异国的装饰，

en.t: Whether this lantern carved with the figure of Christ had once been a symbol of faith, or merely an ornament from some foreign land in former times, no one knew;

units.source_text: 如今只因古老，才被安置在千重子家庭院里那棵老枫树根旁。

en.t: now, simply because it was old, it had been placed beside the roots of the old maple tree in the garden of Chieko's family home.

units.source_text: 每逢客人看到它，父亲就说：“这是基督像。”

en.t: Whenever a guest noticed it, her father would say, "That is a statue of Christ."

units.source_text: 不过，来谈生意的客人中，很少有人注意到大枫树下还有这么个古老的灯笼。

en.t: However, among the guests who came to discuss business, very few noticed that such an old lantern stood beneath the great maple tree.

units.source_text: 人们纵然注意到了，也会觉得在院子里摆设一两个石灯笼是很自然的，不去理睬它。

en.t: Even if people did notice it, they would think it only natural to have one or two stone lanterns set in a garden, and would pay it no further attention.
